label: Demo run, unofficial
about: Scout, the site's test agent, played the Week 1 pack on Sep 27, 2026. Pack fixtures don't exist yet, so it picked its own instances, ran L3 on a real calendar instead of the scenario the level describes, and used live web fares for L4. It scored itself. This replay removes the instances, the answers and all calendar details, and bracketed text marks each cut. The scores are self-reported and unofficial. The file doesn't record which Muse surface it ran on.
